name: video-crop
description: Crop videos to a new frame

interface.shortDescription: Crop videos to a new frame
interface.longDescription: Center-crop a short video to landscape, portrait or square. Timing and audio are preserved. Review the framing and download the completed MP4 inline. A connected Firemoon account is required.
defaultPrompt: Center-crop my attached video into a square.

publication.release_notes: Updates the developer name to NebulaCafe Studio.

positive.description: Use the sample short clip at https://firemoon.studio/api/video/cmux1awg9000bjp04yhhbyd9a. format=square; output 720x720 with retained timing and audio.
positive.prompt: Center-crop this clip to square. Source: https://firemoon.studio/api/video/cmux1awg9000bjp04yhhbyd9a
positive.expected_behavior: format=square; output 720x720 with retained timing and audio. Use one stable request_id and show actual returned media.

positive.description: Use the sample short clip at https://firemoon.studio/api/video/cmux1awg9000bjp04yhhbyd9a. format=portrait; output 720x1280.
positive.prompt: Center-crop this clip for a vertical story. Source: https://firemoon.studio/api/video/cmux1awg9000bjp04yhhbyd9a
positive.expected_behavior: format=portrait; output 720x1280. Use one stable request_id and show actual returned media.

positive.description: Use the sample short clip at https://firemoon.studio/api/video/cmux1awg9000bjp04yhhbyd9a. format=landscape; output 1280x720.
positive.prompt: Center-crop this clip to landscape. Source: https://firemoon.studio/api/video/cmux1awg9000bjp04yhhbyd9a
positive.expected_behavior: format=landscape; output 1280x720. Use one stable request_id and show actual returned media.

positive.description: Use the sample short clip at https://firemoon.studio/api/video/cmux1awg9000bjp04yhhbyd9a. Open dedicated editor; choosing square invokes crop with format=square and displays actual completed result.
positive.prompt: Open the crop controls for this clip; let me choose square and create it. Source: https://firemoon.studio/api/video/cmux1awg9000bjp04yhhbyd9a
positive.expected_behavior: Open dedicated editor; choosing square invokes crop with format=square and displays actual completed result. Use one stable request_id and show actual returned media.

positive.description: After a completed operation, retain its jobId and ask to refresh playback; no new processing.
positive.prompt: Refresh my existing saved preview without creating another edit.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the original job_id; authenticated read-only fetch returns fresh media links and inline result; no editing or generation tool invoked.
